message: Day two of periodic exams was over.
Somehow, I managed to beat every subject.
I felt like soaking in that sense of liberation and having a big stretch. Might as well do it somewhere wide open with a nice view.

name: Synn
message: 「Th-The Sweets Club is in a place like this?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh my, Synn-kun came to our sweets pep rally too~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Behold, that vast sky!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Beneath this sky, there are thousands, tens of thousands of different sweets.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Compared to that, no matter how hard you try on a test, the best you can get is a mere 100 points. So small, so tiny!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir.」
Surrounded by a magnificent view, Nanaka is giving an illogical and terribly petty speech. As her childhood friend, should I be stopping her?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Look~! Beyond that sky lies infinite outer space~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Over there, interplanetary wars for mutual survival and battles over the space-time continuum are probably raging right now, don't you think~?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, even if you phrase it as a question, I have no idea how to answer that...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Compared to that, it's just a test. Tiny, so tiny~」

name: Yumil
message: 「Yessir.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is Okamoto-san listening to this so earnestly?」

name: Yumil
message: 「I used to be a repeat offender for failing grades, see, but thanks to a sleep-learning kit I got through mail order, I'm feeling confident this time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whaaat~!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yumil, you're excommunicated as of today!」

name: Yumil
message: 「Wh-Why is that!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Then~, that means our next sweets tasting party is Yumil's treat~. All in favor raise your hands~, haaai~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaai! Passed 2 to 1, huh... Man, democracy is wonderful.」

name: Yumil
message: 「That's totally dictatorial! President, please do something!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh~~」
With great effort, I coax and calm down Nanaka and Sacchin, who had gone half-desperate.
In the end, it took nearly an hour to talk the Sweets Club president and vice president out of their tyranny.
All I wanted to do here was stretch and take a deep breath…… I'm exhausted.
